fundamentals.name: Airbnb, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Strong revenue growth and profitability metrics are tempered by a low operating margin and a recent earnings miss.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates by 14.1%; next earnings date is 2026-08-05.
positives: Revenue growth 17.9% YoY, with analyst estimates for the current fiscal year at 25.2%.
Gross margin 82.9% and Profit margin 19.9% indicate strong pricing power and efficiency.
Return on equity 32.3% demonstrates effective use of shareholder investments.
Free cash flow of $3.19B provides significant financial flexibility.
Analyst consensus is a 'buy' with a mean target of $156.51.
negatives: Operating margin is a low 3.2%, suggesting high operational costs relative to revenue.
Last quarter's EPS missed estimates by 14.1%.
Forward P/E of 22.23 is still substantial given the recent earnings miss.

news.paragraph: Airbnb Inc. stock saw a gain of 3.4% recently, outperforming the market and attracting investor attention, with one report noting its presence in Jeff Bezos's portfolio. The company has also expanded its offerings to include grocery orders and hotels, signaling strategic growth initiatives. While the stock has shown positive momentum, its valuation metrics and recent earnings surprise warrant a closer look.
